acceptance_predicates.description: The extractor identifies every entity that stores or transports a configuration setting from initial setup through results, including config, selection, plan, catalogs, project files, process environment/argv, runtime handoff, cassettes, and result/report artifacts.
Every registry field has explicit read/write/derive links to its storage entities, with secret-bearing locations classified and values redacted.
Entity extraction covers create, update, validate, execute, record/replay, report, compare, and cleanup lifecycle transitions.

definition_of_done: ASB can emit a complete storage/entity inventory and field-to-entity relation set for the full benchmark lifecycle.

inputs.description: Config, plan, selection, catalog, process, cassette, and result persistence contracts.

outputs.description: Machine-readable entity inventory with storage kind, lifecycle, field relations, and redaction policy.

gates.description: Lifecycle fixtures prove all registry fields have at least one justified storage/transport relation and no secret value is emitted.
